notes: Leadership resolves to sched-node-07 on a single 'election resolved winner=' line that shares no wording with the query ('holding cluster leadership'), buried among ~30 near-identical heartbeat/candidate/dispatch lines naming the same node ids. At a ~10% budget bm25 has zero query-term overlap to exploit and drops it, as do recency and llmlingua_style; only frequency's rare-token weighting happens to surface the line. The term and audit-ref atoms sit on separate lines and are force-kept regardless of selector.
